title: Mechanism-indexed evaluation protocol for multi-step decision pipelines
hypothesis: Mechanism-indexed evaluation reveals failure modes that aggregate task scores hide.
novelty_source: Connects intervention-style diagnostics with benchmark design
Separates mechanism-level failure from end-task metric fluctuations
method_sketch: Define mechanism probes and intervention controls, then evaluate under matched task families.
experiment_sketch: Compare standard aggregate metrics vs mechanism-indexed metrics across robust and stress settings.
risks: Intervention controls may increase evaluation cost

similar_work.reason: Studies robustness metrics but not mechanism-indexed diagnostics
